title: Beyond the Horizon
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: Elara Fontaine, a quiet architecture student in Paris, meets a warm, laughing bookshop owner and discovers love that transcends oceans and continents.
style: Elegant, warm third-person prose. Vivid sensory description, romantic and hopeful, with a film-like quality.
characters: Elara Fontaine — architecture student who came to Paris to disappear; a tall, dark-haired bookshop owner with warm brown eyes.
notes: Early chapters — the meeting in the rain at the bookshop. Develop their connection slowly and beautifully; keep the promise of faraway horizons.
